answer: Rod withdrawal is rate-limited: rods move in small steps, so reactivity cannot jump. Rate-limit influence the same way. A new key's voting weight may rise only a small step per epoch, capped however many tasks it completes. A plume of fresh keys gains nothing quickly, and by the time weight builds, the network has watched each long enough to spot shared pigment in their answers. Velvet-smooth arrival bursts are throttled by design.
